exposure: Multiparous women without previous cesarean delivery
cohort: Women with previous cesarean delivery and breech presentation who underwent ECV at or after 36 weeks of pregnancy during 2011-2016, compared to a control group of multiparous women without previous cesarean delivery matched for age and pregnancy duration.
finding: ECV success rates were similar between women with and without previous cesarean delivery, but successful vaginal delivery after successful ECV was significantly lower in women with previous cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: While external cephalic version (ECV) was similarly successful in women with and without previous cesarean delivery, successful vaginal delivery after successful ECV was lower in the previous cesarean delivery group.
